name: Furuhashi Ayana
source: Kazuki's older sister, she serves as a gentle, motherly figure in his life after the death of their parents. She has a thoughtful, modest personality. She runs a coffee shop during the day while also taking care of the house where she, Kazuki, and Suzuna live.
